briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as frontier labs release iterative models with enhanced reasoning. Funding surges past $11B this quarter amid escalating compute investments. DialectForge gains traction in security protocols.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 2T parameters focused on agentic workflows. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and xAI Grok 3 compete on long-context tasks. DeepSeek-V4 challenges cost curves while Meta releases Llama 4 weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become the default security layer before 2027?
